definition: TRUE when at least one non-zero modelled loss year occurs in the 5,000-year catalogue.
Number of non-zero modelled loss years; zero for corridor municipalities absent from the positive-loss extract.
Catalogue frequency n/5,000; zero for no-event corridor municipalities.
5,000/n for positive-loss municipalities only; undefined for no-event cases.
Two-category catalogue outcome. It is not an observation of an engineering protection standard or zero real-world flood risk.
